VALID_RETEST_ANCHORS.rule: an entry retest level must be one of: a 2-minute, 3-minute or 5-minute moving average; a VWAP level; or a volume-profile level.
VALID_RETEST_ANCHORS.not_valid: moving averages on any timeframe higher than 5 minutes (including the 15m and 60m MAs), Bollinger outer bands, and Fibonacci retracement levels. None of these may be used as retest_level.
VALID_RETEST_ANCHORS.scope: this constrains retest_level only. It says nothing about direction, conviction, targets, stop placement, or whether to take at all.
VALID_RETEST_ANCHORS.orchestrator_enforcement: the orchestrator validates retest_level against this rule before simulating a fill and rejects a take row that violates it.

CANCEL_IF_REACHES_RULE.rule: cancel_if_reaches is ALWAYS your first target. If price reaches TP1 before the limit fills, the move has gone without you and the order is cancelled.
CANCEL_IF_REACHES_RULE.consequence: your choice of TP1 therefore does two jobs: it sets the first target AND it sets the distance the order will tolerate before being abandoned.
CANCEL_IF_REACHES_RULE.orchestrator_enforcement: the orchestrator rejects a take row whose cancel_if_reaches price is not equal to targets[0].price.

level_visits_this_session._source: scripts.level_visits - MECHANICAL FACT under runbook 0c. Counts takes already adjudicated at this level THIS SESSION (the current candidate counts as visit 1) and completed 15m candles in the last 60 minutes whose range contained it. Passes are not visits. A candidate re-adjudicated after an escalation is ONE take.
level_visits_this_session._what_it_governs: tv-trigger 0.4.8: freshness CAPS THE GRADE and nothing else. Only a fresh level may grade A; a stale one tops out at B; a third visit caps at C. The LICENCE is untouched - a T48 re-entry stays licensed, it just no longer comes at A size.

chop_state.doctrine: CHOP + in_middle -> the middle is dead. CHOP + at an edge -> the only licensed trade is from that edge toward the opposite edge.
chop_state._source: scripts.chop_state - MECHANICAL FACT under runbook 0c. His definition implemented literally: a SMALL range (bottom quartile of the normal 3-hour NQ range, ~104pt over 44 days) that has LASTED about three hours. Size and duration only.
chop_state._what_it_governs: tv-trigger 0.4.9: chop tells you HOW to trade, not whether to. In CHOP an edge trigger is licensed toward the far side, targeting the STRUCTURAL level near it rather than the range extreme; the middle is dead; and an edge fade is NOT counter-trend, so it does not cap at C.
